releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.94 improves WhatsApp Status actions and video previews. The 3-dot menu is now the same for photos and videos: Share, Category and Delete saved copy; Open externally has been removed. Category reuses Smart Life's existing category picker and stores only the assignment, without moving or duplicating the saved Status file. Video Status tiles now show a real frame thumbnail with a play overlay. The thumbnail is generated once and cached locally for fast future loads. Normal taps still open photos and videos directly inside Smart Life.
